items.summary: A local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. Run Codex, Claude, and Grok with dedicated workspaces, task queues, file sharing, browser control, and agent-to-agent collaboration.
items.excerpt: # OpenBot [![CI](https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/actions/workflows/ci.yml/badge.svg)](https://github.com/nightly-labs/openbot/actions/workflows/ci.yml) [![License](https://img.shields.io/badge/license-PolyForm_Noncommercial_1.0.0-blue.svg)](LICENSE) OpenBot is a local-first desktop workspace for persistent AI teammates. It supports the local [Codex App Server](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/app-server) and [Claude Code](https://code.claude.com/docs/en/overview), plus [Grok CLI](https://docs.x.ai/build/overview), OpenCode, Gemini, [Cursor CLI](https://cursor.com/cli), and [Cline CLI](https://cline.bot/cli) through ACP. It gives every agent its own workspace and conversation, and provides local queues, file transfers, an embedded browser, and agent-to-agent messaging in one desktop app. > [!WARNING] > OpenBot is a development preview. Agents currently run with `danger-full-access` and > `approvalPolicy: never`. They can read and modify files, run commands, use the network, and control > the embedded browser without per-action confirmations after the explicit first-launch consent. > Run only agents and tasks you trust, keep backups, and review [Security](#security) before use. ## What works - Prompt-driven agent creation and editing on desktop and mobile, with editable instructions, avatar, and section review before saving. - Persistent agents backed by independent Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, Gemini, Cursor, or Cline sessions and local workspaces. - Custom…

items.title: garrytan / gstack
items.summary: Use Garry Tan's exact Claude Code setup: 23 opinionated tools that serve as CEO, Designer, Eng Manager, Release Manager, Doc Engineer, and QA
items.excerpt: # gstack gstack turns Claude Code (and other coding agents) into a virtual engineering team: a CEO who rethinks the product, an eng manager who locks architecture, a designer who catches AI slop, a reviewer who finds production bugs, a QA lead who opens a real browser, a security officer who runs OWASP + STRIDE audits, and a release engineer who ships the PR. All slash commands, all Markdown, all free, MIT license. I'm [Garry Tan](https://x.com/garrytan), President & CEO of [Y Combinator](https://www.ycombinator.com/). This is the open source software factory I use every day, and I'm sharing it because these tools should be available to everyone. The story, the productivity numbers and how I run ten sprints at once are in [Why gstack](docs/why-gstack.md). Fork it. Improve it. Make it yours. And if you want to hate on free open source software — you're welcome to, but I'd rather you just try it first. **Who this is for:** - **Founders and CEOs** — especially technical ones who still want to ship - **First-time Claude Code users** — structured roles instead of a blank prompt - **Tech leads and staff engineers** — rigorous review, QA, and release automation on every PR ## Quick start 1. Install gstack (two pastes, about 30 seconds of setup; see below). 2. Run `/office-hours` and describe what you're building. It pushes back on your framing and writes a design doc the other skills read. 3. Run `/review` on any branch with changes. It finds the bugs that pass CI but break in…

items.summary: Inception's Mercury 3 is a diffusion LLM running at 1,000+ tokens/sec, and Mercury Decide is a decision model that can now read images. Here's how they compare, what the independent evals say, and how fast they really are. Thanks to Inception for sponsoring this video. items.summary: This Claude Code workflow from Google tears apart your plan before your agent builds anything. We show how to use Claude Code agents with zero context to review it, the Claude Code setup to install it, and how it caught a real bug in our app. If you build with AI coding tools, watch this first. The Elephant remembers everything about your project. It talks through your idea with you and writes the detailed plan. The Goldfish are Claude Code agents with zero context.
